repo.description: Watched repository as owner/name — REQUIRED per deployment. Drives the webhook repo filter and the route node's defensive re-check.

webhook_secret_env.description: Env var holding this repo's webhook HMAC secret — the BUPHA_WH_<OWNER>_<REPO> convention (uppercased, '-' → '_'). REQUIRED per deployment; the var must exist in the campaign service env (~/.config/peregrin/env or cuora).

checkout.description: Local clone path lasius operates on — REQUIRED per deployment.

deploy_ref.description: Full git ref whose pushes trigger a deploy — also the webhook driver's push_refs filter. Deploys fire on merges to the default branch; PR-branch pushes never reach the campaign.

worktree_base.description: Deploy worktrees land here — ONE persistent dir per service (deploy-<repo>), reused across shas via `lasius vcs checkout`; not removed between runs.

install_cmd.description: Dependency install run at the worktree root before deploy_cmd — the worktree is persistent so node_modules survives between deploys; bun's global cache covers lockfile changes.

deploy_cmd.description: The deploy itself, run at the worktree root — REQUIRED per deployment. e.g. 'bun run build && bun run deploy' for the alchemy services, 'bun run deploy' where the script self-builds.

cooldown_secs.description: Minimum seconds between deploy starts per service — the run sleeps this long AFTER the deploy+status settle. Must stay under the cooldown node's 3660s timeout.

status_context.description: Commit-status context posted on each deployed sha (pending → success/failure), e.g. 'deploy/product'. Empty disables status posts entirely.

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.
